description: Send a new email from a connected mailbox. Plain text by default; HTML when the body contains tags or html=true.

account.description: Which connected mailbox to use (its label from mailroom_accounts). Optional when only one is connected or a default is saved in memory.

html.description: Treat the body as HTML (default: detected from the body).

to.description: Recipient address, or several separated by commas.

name: mailroom_send
